copy: Coaching, workouts, and macro-friendly nutrition in your language.
AI coach in the creator's voice, bilingual English and Spanish

steal.title: Fewest-taps logging + human-verified food data (MacroFactor)
steal.note: Match MacroFactor's ~50% fewer taps and human-vetted entries to kill the category's #1 friction and the duplicate-entry problem

steal.title: Snap-first onboarding (Cal AI UX, not its billing)
steal.note: Adopt the frictionless 'just take a photo' first-run; reject the hidden pricing that got Cal AI pulled from the App Store

steal.title: Streaks with grace days (Duolingo)
steal.note: Streak shields lifted long-term retention; pairs with a daily nutrition log or workout check-in

steal.title: Creator monetization track (Trainerize)
steal.note: On-demand + phased programs, membership bundles, challenges as digital products in her brand

steal.title: Automated onboarding + at-risk flows (Everfit Autoflow)
steal.note: Scheduled onboarding sequences and re-engagement triggers

steal.title: 15-min re-engagement workouts + before/after sharing (Sweat)
steal.note: Short workouts win back lapsed users; before/after community sharing is the belief loop that built a $100M app

steal.title: Founding-member launch cohort
steal.note: 500-spot locked-price cohort to the 256 existing clients + waitlist; seeds the community with believers

steal.title: Country-filterable Latin food DB + cooked/raw toggle (Fitia)
steal.note: Match Fitia's LATAM food depth and native raw/cooked toggle, wrapped in Steph's voice

whitespace.title: Creator-led bilingual full-stack for Latina women
whitespace.note: The intersection nobody owns: Fitia owns faceless bilingual nutrition, Peloton owns bilingual mass classes; no one fuses accurate bilingual nutrition with a trusted creator relationship

whitespace.title: Photo portion + cooked/raw accuracy on Latin home cooking
whitespace.note: Every photo app trains on Western stock food; Sydney 2024 found beef pho +49%, milk tea -76%; even Fitia's photo layer is soft

whitespace.title: Retention/churn intelligence in the creator's voice
whitespace.note: Auto at-risk detection at the 90-day cliff and <3-workouts-in-14-days signal; re-engage in her voice - absent across all platforms

whitespace.title: Health-mission framing (Hispanic disparities)
whitespace.note: Highest obesity prevalence + 32.1% inactivity among US Hispanics; culturally-tailored Spanish interventions proven effective - differentiation, press, and retention

prioritize.title: Tune photo-to-macro for Latin home cooking
prioritize.note: Surface cooked/raw prominently; the 'understands your abuela's cooking' wedge no photo app has solved

prioritize.title: Churn intelligence: 90-day cliff + 14-day workout signal
prioritize.note: Extend the existing /coach/intelligence surface to flag at-risk members and trigger re-engagement

prioritize.title: Recurring cohort challenges + leaderboard + finisher recognition
prioritize.note: 30-60% engagement lift, native to how she coaches

prioritize.title: Reposition nutrition as 'Steph's method, automated'
prioritize.note: Out-trust Fitia, do not out-tech it; her method + her voice is the authenticity wedge

prioritize.title: MyFitnessPal import + barcode + fast logging
prioritize.note: Neutralize the #1 friction; MFP import is table stakes among coaching platforms

quickWins.title: Anti-chargeback trio: brand descriptor + trial-ending reminder + one-click cancel
quickWins.note: Brand billing descriptor (THICKANDFIT), a trial-ending email 3 days out with exact amount + date, and one-click in-app cancel - the 3 highest-impact chargeback fixes, directly countering Lenus and Cal AI billing complaints

quickWins.title: Push the annual plan as the flagship option
quickWins.note: Annual retains 40-60% better, cuts churn ~51%, and already drives 60.6% of fitness category revenue

quickWins.title: Day-1 activation: 'snap your first meal, macros in 10 seconds'
quickWins.note: Instrument first-log/first-workout within 48h (target 40%+); a 10-point activation lift yields 15-20% better 30-day retention; defer the long intake

quickWins.title: Exercise-library search that actually works
quickWins.note: Trainerize ('an absolute joke') and Everfit both fail at basic exercise search; cheap to beat with good tagging
